title: test(i18n): derive console.objectView survivors from en instead of pinning counts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9UqY9fBL2b73xq6oRApRHbw)_
Fixes #26438
Part of #26431

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectView-config-keys-retired-4730.test.ts` 去掉三个手打计数（存活键 103、合计 229、退役清单长度 126），存活键集合改为从 en 包派生。
- 为什么改：每往 `console.objectView` 加一个正常的新键，这个测试就红，只能改数字；它要守的只是「退役键不回来」。
- 风险与回滚：只改一个测试文件，不发布任何东西；回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/__tests__/objectView-config-keys-retired-4730.test.ts` 第一个 `it`（计数换成去重 + 非空检查）和第三个 `it` 开头（`toHaveLength(SURVIVING_KEY_COUNT)` 换成非空检查）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/i18n/src/__tests__/objectView-config-keys-retired-4730.test.ts`（在 `ui/` 下），预期 5/5 通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One test file, test-only (`skip-changeset`: nothing under any package's `files[]` moves).

- **Deleted** `SURVIVING_KEY_COUNT = 103`, the `RETIRED + SURVIVING == 229` sum, `enKeys toHaveLength(SURVIVING_KEY_COUNT)` and the retired list's own `toHaveLength(126)`.
- **Kept, unchanged:** `RETIRED_OBJECT_VIEW_KEYS` (every name), the assertion that no pack defines any retired key (named pack and key in the failure), the assertion that every pack holds exactly `en`'s `console.objectView` key set (local CLDR plural slots excepted, as before), the live-sample translation check, and the `t()` reader scan.
- **Replaced with anti-vacuity:** the retired list is non-empty and has no duplicate name (`new Set(list).size === list.length`); the `en` root is non-empty; `LANGS` contains `en`.
- **Comments:** the arithmetic history (116 → 118 → … → 126 retired, 209 → … → 229 total, 104 → 105 → 103 surviving) is removed; each later retirement round keeps its provenance paragraph, retitled by key name instead of by count.

No forced test edits: the only test touched is the one this card names.

## Why

The file exists to prove that the objectui#4730 config-panel vocabulary never comes back. That needs the retired NAMES and a live-set comparison against `en`; a hand-typed surviving count adds nothing to it and reds on every legitimate addition (objectui#13052 and objectui#13330 each had to bump it). The retired list's length pin was the same transcription one level over: the names already pin the list, so the count only made each retirement a two-place edit.

Card acceptance, measured below: adding a `console.objectView.*` key changes no test; retiring one still requires the list edit.

## Tests

All runs at head `3ce8863d`, under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

- Target file: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 5 passed (5)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n test --maxWorkers=2`: `Test Files 87 passed (87)`, `Tests 1353 passed | 13 skipped (1366)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0; `--listFiles` on `tsconfig.test.json` lists this test file (1 hit).

### Ablation

Each leg mutates a locale pack through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit once, blob must change, restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`), inside a script with an EXIT/INT/TERM trap. 12 of 12 restores reported `ok restored`; `git status --porcelain` empty afterwards. The locale packs are not in this diff.

| Leg | Mutation | Result |
|:---|:---|:---|
| A | retired `groupBy` put back into `en`'s `console.objectView` | **red**: 2 failed / 3 passed. `no pack defines any retired key` names `en :: console.objectView.groupBy`; the shape test reds too (9 packs now lack an `en` key) |
| B | retired `groupBy` put back into `zh` only | **red**: 2 failed / 3 passed. Names `zh :: console.objectView.groupBy`; the shape test reds on `zh` |
| C1 | a new key `ablationNewKey26438` added to all ten packs, this PR's test | **green**: 5/5 |
| C2 | same mutation, `main`'s test (byte copy of `00a4593a`'s file) | **red**: 1 failed / 4 passed, `expected [ 'ablationNewKey26438', …(103) ] to have a length of 103 but got 104` |

C1 against C2 is the defect the card names, before and after.

## Acceptance notes

- `expect(LANGS).toHaveLength(10)` stays. It pins the locale roster, not this namespace, and the same line sits in eight sibling i18n test files plus `entry-locale-shape-7479.test.ts`; retiring it in one file alone would leave the roster pinned everywhere else. It belongs to the roster's own entry in the #26431 sweep if that sweep wants it.
- The shape test still reds when a key is added to `en` alone. That is the parity rule (`all-locales-key-parity.test.ts` holds it repo-wide), not a count; leg C adds the key to every pack, which is what a legitimate addition does.

## Verification

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `3ce8863d` derived 24 commands; all 24 ran with exit 0, reconciled with `--ran`: `24 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 24 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 24 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` first exited 1 on a missing prerequisite (`Cannot find package '@objectstack/spec/ui'`, spec not built in this fresh container). After `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/i18n^...' --filter=@objectstack/spec` it ran green: `Test Files 178 passed | 2 skipped (180)`, `Tests 5097 passed | 2 skipped (5099)`.

The type-check lanes, artifact rosters and wide-population families that the derivation prints outside its total are left to CI.

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (left to CI's `Lint UI`)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
